data.name: Norbu
data.gender_notes: Norbu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Tibetan word 'nor bu', meaning 'protector' or 'guardian'. It is a name of great significance in Tibetan Buddhism, representing strength, courage, and the ability to ward off negative energies. The name Norbu carries the meaning “Protector, Fighter, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tibetan tradition and is also used in Tibetan. Parents who choose Norbu usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, fighter, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Norbu is a name deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of Tibetan Buddhism. It signifies protection, courage, and the power to overcome adversity. It is believed that those named Norbu are born with a strong spiritual foundation and a natural ability to defend against negativity.
data.etymology: Norbu belongs to the Tibetan linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Fighter, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Norbu total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Norbu was a title given to the monarchs of the Tibetan empire during the period of the Phagmo Druk lineage. The name Norbu means 'precious jewel' in Tibetan.
historical_references.context: Phagmo Druk lineage of Tibetan monarchs

historical_references.reference: The Tibetan king Norbu Gonpo (1481-1542) was known for his military conquests, which expanded the Tibetan empire significantly. He was also a patron of Buddhism and supported the spread of Tibetan Buddhism in Central and Eastern Tibet.
historical_references.context: Military conquests and patronage of Buddhism during the rule of Norbu Gonpo
